text:
amy: FYI we're planning to onboard model `cobalt-3b-v2` into the catalog tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Need: deploy owner, smoke runner, and rollback plan.

jordan: I can take deploy owner. What's the pin strategy? full pin or variant alias?

kai: +1 for jordan as owner. Recommend pin to `cobalt-3b:v2` for the canary window, keep `cobalt-3b:stable` pointing to v1 until smoke passes.

sam: I can run the smoke tests at +5/ +30 mins after canary start. What's the quick smoke checklist?

kai: Smoke checklist (short):
1) inference < 200ms p95 on small prompt set
2) end-to-end request via http OK with tokenization sanity
3) regression alerts off baseline prompts (quick eval)

kai: Example health check curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"cobalt-3b:v2","input":"Hello"}'
```

maria: For canary, propose 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 30m if no regressions, then full swap. If anything odd, rollback to `cobalt-3b:v1`.

jordan: Sounds good. Rollback runbook: 1) pin `cobalt-3b:stable` -> v1 (api call), 2) revoke canary routing, 3) notify SRE + product. Kai, can you draft the API call?

kai: API call to pin (example):
```
POST /catalog/pin
{
  "model":"cobalt-3b",
  "tag":"stable",
  "version":"v1"
}
```
I'll paste the real CLI snippet in the deploy thread tomorrow.

sam: I'll be on the smoke run and will post short logs to this thread. Prefer to run smoke from staging region us-west-2.

amy: Team, status check: who's available for rollback within 15m of a failing smoke? jordan + kai + sam listed? 

jordan: I'm on-call tomorrow morning until 11:30 PDT, so available for rollback. :thumbsup:

kai: I can be available for the swap and quick fixes until noon.

maria: I'll monitor quality dashboards and trigger alerts. I'll handle product-side comms.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: catalog onboard job queued for 2024-06-12T17:00:00Z by amy (id: cb-123).

amy: Great. Plan:
- 10:00 PDT: start canary (5%). jordan triggers pin to `cobalt-3b:v2` for canary routing.
- 10:05 PDT: sam runs smoke 1, posts pass/fail.
- 10:35 PDT: if green, increase to 25%. sam runs smoke 2.
- 11:05 PDT: if green, full swap to v2. rollback window until 11:30 PDT.

amy: Last ask: please leave a short comment in the catalog PR with the pin note and who ran smoke. I'll merge after confirmation.

sam: Copy that — will paste smoke logs + perf numbers.

jordan: I'll handle the PR comment and make the pin change via CLI.

amy: Thanks everyone — tagging the list: @jordan @kai @sam @maria. See you in deploy thread tomorrow. :rocket:
